acquisition_method.evidence: We used data-independent acquisition (DIA), with full MS resolution set to 120,000 at m/z 200 and full MS AGC target set at 300%, with an injection time of 45 ms.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Cells were lysed with boiling guanidine-hydrochloride lysis buffer (6 M Gnd-HCl, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 5 TCEP, 10 mM CAA).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Cells were lysed with boiling guanidine-hydrochloride lysis buffer (6 M Gnd-HCl, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 5 TCEP, 10 mM CAA).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were pre-digested with endoproteinase Lys-C (Wako) for 2 h at room temperature in an enzyme/protein ratio of 1:100.
before overnight digestion with trypsin (Sigma-Aldrich) at 37 °C in an enzyme/protein ratio of 1:50.

collision_energy.evidence: Normalized collision energy was set at 27%.

enrichment_method.evidence: Ti-IMAC phosphopeptide enrichment was carried out on a KingFisher™ Flex robot (Thermo Fisher Scientific) (15) in 96-well format, as previously described (16).

fractionation_method.evidence: High-pH reversed-phase stage-tip fractionation of phosphopeptides Labeled phosphopeptides were manually fractionated using high-pH reversed-phase chromatography in stage-tips, as previously described (16).

labeling.evidence: 750 ng of digested peptides for single-shot proteome analysis were loaded on C18 Evotips (Evosep) for MS analysis.
